offer.title: A note from the venue
offer.body: A small venue has a five-day trial for a guitarist. The job begins in the next chapter.
offer.prepared: Your Practice L{level} locks in a {bonus}% Prepared Performer bonus for those first five workdays.
offer.unprepared: You can accept now, but there won't be a Prepared Performer bonus.
offer.declineNote: Say no for now and the letter will return on Sunday.
offer.announcement: A letter has arrived. The game is paused for your answer.

accepted.title: First gigs, booked
accepted.body: You're set to start {weekday}, Day {day}. Prepared Performer is locked at {bonus}% for your first five workdays.
accepted.bodyWithoutBonus: You're set to start {weekday}, Day {day}. You accepted before Practice L1, so there is no Prepared Performer bonus.
accepted.terminal: That's the end of this chapter. Your first shift begins in the next one.

summary.accepted: First gigs start {weekday}, Day {day}. Prepared Performer: {bonus}%. The first shift begins in the next chapter.
